why_best: This spatial handoff establishes clear visual hierarchy and narrative progression within a tight square canvas without cluttering the screen or cutting away.
why_bad: An abrupt cut or simple opacity cross-dissolve destroys the illusion of physical depth and fails to communicate the spatial relationship between the two subjects.
trap: A near-miss will shift the dimensional perspective but forget to soften the receded element, leaving competing items equally sharp and destroying the intended hierarchy.
